chapter_notes_tr: Açılış hüzünlü ve sakin; 1-1 iki başlangıç karakteriyle ücretsiz savaş tutorial'ı. Brin, ücretsiz 4★ seçim daveti ve Nixie sayesinde tam beş kişilik kadro 1-4 sonunda garanti edilir.

opening_scene.title_en: A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep
opening_scene.direction_en: Black screen. Rain ticks on an abandoned roadside shrine. Fadyme, alone for one breath, presses a blood-marked glove to a letter and writes by candlelight. She folds the page before Mahmut enters. A distant bell rings once; ash drifts upward instead of down.
opening_scene.music_cue: Felt piano and low cello; leave two seconds of silence after the first bell.

lines.text_en: If I wake before the bell tomorrow, I will call it luck. If I do not... Mahmut must never read this page.
One month, perhaps less. The old physician wrote it in Mother's prayer book. The ink does not tremble. I do.
You missed supper. I saved the part that did not burn.
Then it is a feast. I am perfectly fine.
Your hand is shaking.
The cold has found my fingers. It has not found the rest of me.
She hides the red stain beneath her cuff. He offers his cloak. She takes it, and lets him believe the warmth helped.
Princess. The road ends at the altar. Give me the last hour before it takes you.
You will not take her anywhere.
I came to stop the bell, not to kill its prisoner. You cannot guard a door that has already chosen its offering.
Then it can choose someone who is not under my shield.
Do you know her?
No.
I know the bell she carries. And I know what it means when it rings for me.
When the names begin to vanish, remember: I warned you.
Yseldra leaves a seven-notched gray seal on Mahmut’s shield. Fadyme turns away before he can see that she is crying.

tutorial_team_rule.guided_exception: Stage 1-1 is a free, no-Ration guided battle with Mahmut and Fadyme only.

scenes.direction_en: At gray dawn, ash leaves whisper the names carved into them. Mahmut hears only wind; Fadyme hears one syllable spoken in her mother’s voice.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Combat resolves automatically. Speed sets turn order; heroes choose Basic and Active skills. Watch the intent icons, then let the formation do its work.
Focus is full. Tap a glowing hero portrait to choose when to use an Ultimate, or enable Auto Ultimate to let the party decide.
Battles begin at x1. Speed changes animation pace only; it does not change turn order or rewards.

scenes.battle_transition_en: A guided two-hero prologue encounter is the only exception to the normal five-unit party rule. No Ration is spent.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Three wolves. Stay behind my shield.
You say that as if I have ever listened.
The bell has no clapper. Why can I still hear it?

post_battle_lines.text_en: The last one ran when the bell stopped.
It did not stop. It only learned to whisper.
One step. Then another. The road does not need to know how many it costs.

scenes.direction_en: At a collapsed wayshrine, Brin braces a fallen beam while Bellbound Dead scratch at the woodcutters’ shelter. Nixie has been scouting the road; Kera's herb cart is overturned beside the shrine. All three join the guided five-person battle as story loans.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Your company has five battle places: two Front and three Rear. Front heroes draw most close attacks; Rear heroes are safer but can be reached by hunters.
Brin is a story guest for this battle. If you already own her, your copy and equipment take the guest place.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: If I move, the roof comes down. If I stay, they reach the children.
You do not have to hold it alone.
Three hands for the beam and three swords for the dead. We can manage both.
The tracks circle the shrine. We are being pushed toward the road, not away from it.
My cart is full of smoke vials. If someone can throw straight, I can make that pack of corpses regret gathering.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The woodcutters are safe. I will walk with you until the next bell is silent.
That is farther than the next shrine.
Then try to keep up.
I will mark the next stretch before the wolves can double back. You can borrow my bow until we reach the old cart road.
And I am going to retrieve my bottles before they become somebody else's research.
Brin joins permanently as a story recruit. Nixie and Kera remain as temporary story loans for the next stretch. The shrine keeper gives the party a First Oath Invitation.

scenes.direction_en: Glass vials roll down a muddy slope. Kera is defending her overturned cart with a brass hand mortar and a look of personal offense.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Choose one permanent 4★ companion: Tilda, Rikka, Odelia, Pippa, Thistle, Iona or Marek. This guaranteed story invitation is not a banner pull.
Set five heroes in the formation. If Kera is not in your roster, she fills the fifth place as a story guest for this encounter.
Auto uses Basic and Active skills. You can manually fire ready Ultimates; Auto Ultimate is a separate toggle.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Those bottles were sorted by volatility. You have turned them into a choir.
We can help you gather them after the dead are gone.
Good. Try not to step on the red ones. Or the blue ones. Or anything that smells like almonds.

post_battle_lines.text_en: Take this route map. The Red Vial Guild owes me a favor, and now it owes you one too.
You are coming with us?
No. I am going ahead to warn the Guild. This is not concern. It is field research.

scenes.battle_transition_en: Kera fills the fifth battle place as a guest unless the player already owns her. Guest presence never adds a second copy to the party.

scenes.direction_en: A twig snaps above the road. Nixie drops from a low branch, bow already drawn at the shadow behind the party.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Nixie is a guest in this encounter and becomes a permanent story recruit after the clear. Story recruits do not require a pull.
x2 battle speed is now available. Turn order, enemy intent and rewards remain unchanged.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Do not follow the map. The map is lying. The wolves learned the road from it.
And you learned that by climbing a tree?
I learned it by being chased up one. There is a difference.

post_battle_lines.text_en: I was going to Oakhaven anyway. I will take the rear watch.
You do not have to stay with us.
I know. That is why I can choose to.
Nixie joins permanently. The company now has five owned heroes: Mahmut, Fadyme, Brin, Nixie and the companion chosen by invitation.

scenes.direction_en: A dead wolf rises from the shrine ditch with a cracked bell fused through its jaw. The air goes silent around it.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Boss intent appears before it resolves. The jaw-bell is a break target; breaking it interrupts Ash Howl.
Tap a ready portrait to spend Focus on an Ultimate, or let Auto Ultimate choose the timing.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: That is not a wolf. That is what the bell left wearing one.
Front line, hold. Rear line, wait for the jaw to open.
When it opens, strike the clapper. We only get one clean chance.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The bell stopped. The trees are still whispering.
They will forget the sound by morning.
Your hand is freezing.
Rain does that. I am perfectly fine.
My fingertips have gone pale. I will tell him after the next town.

scenes.battle_transition_en: The boss has a visible two-phase transition; intent and target markers remain legible at x1, x2 or x3.

scenes.direction_en: Inside the wayshrine, the old keeper opens a register of oaths. Brin stands guard at the door.

lines.text_en: You saved the woodcutters' children. The road owes you a companion.
We did not ask for payment.
It is not payment. It is an oath. Travelers write here that they will walk for someone else when called.
And they come? Just like that?
The oath binds their road to yours before your paths truly cross. You may meet them later as strangers. The oath remembers even when they do not.
A promise that remembers people who forget. I should like one of those.
Choose with care. An invitation can only be written once.

scenes.direction_en: Night after the Ash-Maw. The company camps at the shrine. Far off, a cracked handbell rings once; the ash above the fire drifts up instead of down.

lines.text_en: The trees stopped whispering.
No. Listen. They are whispering someone else's name now.
Beyond the firelight, a single cracked bell rang, then went still.
Her.
She is not coming closer. She wants us to know she is there.
The widow's bell. It rang like that the night Mother's portrait came down.
Sleep. I will watch.
You always say that. One day I will watch, and you will sleep.
